summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting minutes of its 523rd Board of Directors meeting held April 27, 2026. The board approved the appointment of María Cristina Rotondo Urcola as a new board member to fill a vacancy, with her term expiring at the 2028 ordinary general meeting. This is a routine board appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. As it is a standard corporate governance update, the most appropriate category is Management Changes, but with low confidence given its non-disruptive nature.
